from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u008/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The constant center column separates two equally sized panels.
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    width = len(left[0])
    lvals = [v for row in left for v in row]
    rvals = [v for row in right for v in row]
    lbg = Counter(lvals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rbg = Counter(rvals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    if lbg == rbg:
        return [[2 if left[r][c] != lbg or right[r][c] != rbg else 3
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
    shared = set(lvals) & set(rvals)
    common = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == common and right[r][c] == common else common
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(h)]
'''
path=base/'task-666afc59.py'
path.write_text(program)
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskmod',path); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

out=mod.transform(test)
print(out)
